note: The three primary reports (Faraday, Hertz, Cavendish) are historical monographs of the framework's empirical tests; the GUM supplies the measurement/uncertainty vocabulary; Tong supplies the modern lecture-notes context of induction, superposition and energy transport. No quantitative claim is transcribed from the Hertz tables or the Cavendish fractions; all readings, hashes and read extents are recorded per source in this file and were re-fetched and inspected in this batch. The two B-page sources repeat only the exact A-page treatments that bear on the examples (box null geometry; measurement model and corrections).
